description: Land Acquisition - Olaithoduvai, Mannar D/S Division, Mannar District - Kaddukaran Kudiyiruppa, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and acquisition orders for taking possession of these lands. While it mentions a government minister (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando) issuing the orders, the core content focuses exclusively on land/property matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) according to the classification rules.
